description: Research, create, review, and iteratively improve historically grounded Open Bible Images through capability-based workflows.

capabilities: Research biblical and historical visual context
Find and assess historical visual sources
Generate historically grounded Bible image prompts
Review Bible images and route feedback
defaultPrompt: Review this Bible image and investigate anything that needs more research.
Find stronger historical sources for this visual claim and reassess it.
Research this passage and create the complete OBI image data and prompt. Do not generate yet.
interface.longDescription: One OBI creation harness that automatically routes ordinary requests—or follows explicit manual calls—across research, source discovery, entities, composition, character continuity, prompting, image generation, and image review. Version 0.4 adds feedback loops: review findings and external comments can route back to the earliest responsible artifact, gather stronger evidence, revise the affected work, and return to review while preserving lineage and human approval boundaries. Images are generated only when explicitly requested and the plugin never publishes to production OBI data.

name: obi-image-creation
